spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with خود and the right piece begins with را; خود and the object marker را are separate words (محاسن خود را با دست چپ می گیری), so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 348 of 421; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The row is Persian prose and has no Arabic field, so only this one space is in question.
